title: Simultaneous Death
text: {% if will.simultaneous_death == "spouse_survives" %}If my spouse and I die under circumstances where the order of our deaths cannot be established, my spouse shall be deemed to have survived me for purposes of this Will.{% elif will.simultaneous_death == "testator_survives" %}If my spouse and I die under circumstances where the order of our deaths cannot be established, I shall be deemed to have survived my spouse for purposes of this Will.{% endif %}
